descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_repeat_step: Advances the repeat timer and repeatedly increments or decrements an editing spinner.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_reset: Resets the spinner base, releases its held interface, and clears editing state and text resources.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_set_active: Updates active state, reports its configured name, and refreshes controls and visibility.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_increment: Increments and clamps the spinner value, wraps when unchanged, and writes back changed values.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_decrement: Decrements the spinner value with wraparound and writes back changed values.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_set_editing: Changes editing state, updates the input flag, resets repeat timers, and refreshes controls.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_value_changed: Reads the current value and refreshes the spinner unless a write is in progress.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_read_value: Reads an integer or float property, clamps it to the configured limit, and returns the current value.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_write_value: Writes the spinner value to an integer or float property while guarding recursive callbacks.
descriptions.w3d_s4_spinner_clear_texts: Destroys and clears each of three text objects when present.
